CRUD operations for ContactImage records via agent-os CLI

## Usage

```bash

agent-os contact-image update --id <value> [--contactId <value>] [--imageId <value>] [--entityId <value>]
agent-os contact-image delete --id <value>
```

## Examples

### List all contactImage records

```bash
agent-os contact-image list
```

### Create a contactImage

```bash

```

### Get a contactImage by id

